name: canonical-devbox-flox-export
claims: canonical and staged result streams are byte-identical
canonical and staged manager output bytes are byte-identical
canonical and staged receipt bytes are byte-identical
repeated identical exports are deterministic and idempotent
flags and environment variables select equivalent paths
differing human-owned outputs and receipts are not modified
path escape and output-receipt aliasing fail before writes
manager-specific options and unsupported Flox platforms fail closed
runtime export requires no manager executable, network service, or persistent credential
non_claims: offline replay through a manager-native lock
semantic merging of hand-authored manager configuration
